status: EXECUTED — PRIORITY LIFECYCLE FAIL; INVESTIGATION AWAITS SD EVIDENCE
evidence_origin: Owner report supplied for this investigation. Assistant performed no physical test and received no physical SD-card logs or photographs.

observations.input_failure: Menu visually returned after Quit, but keyboard controls, Ctrl+Alt+F2 and Ctrl+C did not respond. This does not identify kernel keyboard mode, foreground process group or the process displaying the Menu.
observations.first_boot: Some screen transitions appeared hung. At least one field showed a UTF/locale-related value; Enter did not behave as expected. Another input appeared to require a technical country code. Back did not reliably return to the preceding screen.
observations.wifi: Typing appeared empty. One attempted passphrase produced an unhelpful settings/error message; a simple alphanumeric test passphrase succeeded. No credential bytes retained, requested or reconstructed. Failure cause is unknown; punctuation is not established as invalid.
observations.baseline: The existing POC3 attestation establishes Menu/VICE/geometry/media/audio/joystick/F10/Quit/responsive return and both VT directions. The current owner additionally identifies working VT switching after POC3 return. POC3 did not contain the new SDL Cover, so it is not a physical Cover baseline.

limits: This additive attestation supersedes the earlier physical-UNTESTED state only for explicitly reported observations; original build and procedure records are unchanged.
An observed application entry is presence evidence, not functional qualification.
Successful Wi-Fi enrollment does not establish external traffic, reboot persistence or correctness for every passphrase.
No actual failed credential, AP identifier or private device identity is recorded.
Exact hardware configuration, display mode, timing, live terminal state and physical-run diagnostic files were not supplied.
